channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tim Grover | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tim Grover from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jamal Crawford on Tim Grover
item.description:
Crawford told The Athletic.

“He hadn’t announced he was coming back to the Wizards as of yet, but he was working out. And so it was six in the morning and his trainer Tim Grover called me, and I was very familiar with him and worked out with him before. And he was like, ‘Hey, M.J. says you can meet him.’ I’m like, all right.’”

Jamal Crawford on Tim Grover, Apr 18, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jared Jeffries on Antoine Walker, Tim Grover
item.description:
While appearing on the 'Wizards Talk' podcast, he told an offseason story involving former NBA All-Star Antoine Walker.

“We were in Chicago at [trainer] Tim Grover's gym. Antoine Walker pulls up in some Ferrari and he was like he just got it. M.J. was like 'you know what? I'm gonna bring a different color Ferrari every day this week with a matching Jumpman jumpsuit.'Bro, he pulled up in a Ferrari with a matching Jumpman jumpsuit for the whole five days we were playing. That's the kind of swag he had,”

Jared Jeffries on Antoine Walker, Tim Grover, Apr 15, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Tim Grover
item.description:
Ethan Sherwood Strauss:Stephen Curry on Tim Grover saying the ankle brace factored into the knee injury:

“Simply a wet spot that put me in a very vulnerable position”

Stephen Curry on Tim Grover, Apr 29, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.
